name: 20001 · Washington, DC
findings: ZIP 20001 (Washington) has 929 nonprofit organizations. 516 of them (56%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 454 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 20001 (Washington) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 20001 (Washington) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 8.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 60 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
